name: CoreCustomAttributes
label: Core Custom Attributes
description: Custom attributes to indicate core DM concepts, may include struct classes intended for use in core custom attributes.

DynamicSchema.label: Dynamic Schema
DynamicSchema.description: Identifies a schema as dynamically generated by an application.  Like versions of a schema may differ and are not guaranteed to merge without conflicts.

PartialSchema.label: Partial Schema
PartialSchema.description: Identifies a schema file/object that may only contain part of the complete schema.  Like versions of a schema may differ but are guaranteed to merge without conflicts.

SchemaNameAndPurpose.description: Used to define a supplemental schema and its purpose

properties.name: SchemaName
properties.description: Full name of the supplemental schema

properties.name: Purpose
properties.description: Purpose of the supplemental schema

SchemaReference.label: Schema Reference
SchemaReference.description: Reference to a schema including name and version

properties.name: SchemaName
properties.description: Name of schema, excluding version
properties.label: Schema Name

properties.name: MajorVersion
properties.description: [This].[Write].[Minor]
properties.label: Major Version

properties.name: MinorVersion
properties.description: [Major].[Write].[This]
properties.label: Minor Version

properties.name: WriteVersion
properties.description: [Major].[This].[Minor]
properties.label: Write Version

SupplementalSchema.label: Supplemental Schema
SupplementalSchema.description: Identifies a schema as a supplemental schema and stores extra metadata necessary for supplemental schemas

properties.name: PrimarySchemaReference
properties.description: References the primary schema this supplemental should be applied to
properties.label: Primary Schema Reference

properties.name: Precedence
properties.description: Positive integer defining the precedence of this supplemental schema. Higher precedences override lower precences.  The primary schema is considered to have a precedence between 199 and 200.

properties.name: Purpose
properties.description: A string representing the function of this supplemental schema.  Standard name formatting for a supplemental schema is <PrimarySchemaName>_Supplemental_<Purpose>

DateTimeInfo.description: Optional additional meta data for DMProperties of type DateTime.

properties.name: DateTimeKind
properties.description: Either Utc, Local or Unspecified. Default: Unspecified. When specifying a DateTimeKind, it is usually not necessary to specify a DateTimeComponent because a DateTimeKind implies the DateTimeComponent 'DateTime'.

properties.name: DateTimeComponent
properties.description: Either DateTime or Date. Default: DateTime. Specifying 'Date' usually implies that a DateTimeKind is irrelevant, because dates (without time) don't need any timezone information.

Localizable.label: Localizable
Localizable.description: Applied to a property to indicate that custom attributes using this property can be localized.

IsMixin.label: Is Mixin
IsMixin.description: Applied to abstract DMEntityClasses which serve as secondary base classes for normal DMEntityClasses.

properties.name: AppliesToEntityClass
properties.description: This mixin may only be applied to entity classes which derive from this class.  Class Name should be fully specified as 'alias:ClassName'

NotSubclassableInReferencingSchemas.description: Makes a class 'sealed' outside of the schema containing the class

properties.name: Exceptions
properties.description: Optionally allows specific classes in other schemas to subclass this class.  Use format '[SchemaName]:[ClassName]', e.g. 'Fruit:Banana'

HiddenProperty.description: Identifies a property which is designed to be hidden from the user interface

properties.name: Show
properties.description: If set to true show the hidden property. Defaults to False.  Allows a property override to show a hidden property in a derived class

HiddenSchema.description: Identifies a schema which is designed to be hidden from the user interface.  By default all classes in the schema are hidden as well.

properties.name: ShowClasses
properties.description: If true classe in the schema will be shown.  Default is False.  If set to true individual classes may be hidden using the HiddenClass custom attribute

HiddenClass.description: Identifies a class which is designed to be hidden from teh user interface.  Hides the class it is applied to and all derived classes

properties.name: Show
properties.description: If set to true show the hidden class.  Defaults to False.  Allows a derived class to be shown even though it's base class is hidden

Deprecated.description: Identifies a schema or item within a schema as deprecated.  Deprecated things should not be used.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: Gives advice about avoiding the deprecated item or other helpful information related to the deprecation of the item.

Extension.description: Used to indicate that the property this custom attribute is applied to is an extension property.

properties.name: Origin
properties.description: Extension origin.

ProductionStatusValue.description: Used with ProductionStatus to declare the schema author's intended and supported workflows for the schema.

enumerators.name: NotForProduction
enumerators.description: This schema is under development and should not be used for production workflows. Data created using this schema is not supported and may not be upgradable.

enumerators.name: FieldTesting
enumerators.description: This schema is suitable for field testing of production workflows. Data created with the schema is not supported long-term and may not be upgradable.

enumerators.name: Production
enumerators.description: This schema is suitable for production workflows. Data created using this schema will be supported long term (possibly through transformation).

enumerators.name: Deprecated
enumerators.description: This schema is no longer recommended for production workflows. Better alternatives exist and should be used instead.

ProductionStatus.description: Declares the suitability of this schema for use in production and other workflows.

properties.name: SupportedUse
properties.description: Indicates the suitability of this schema for production or other usage.

properties.name: Checksum
properties.description: Set when the schema ProductionStatus is set. Used to verify that a validated schema has not been modified after that point.
